api.description: Write or update one KPI entry. kpi_id, source_id and entry_date identify it, so the same trio again updates rather than duplicating. A write with every value empty answers stored: false

fields.description: The user the entry is against.
Identifies the user by email instead of user_id. Send one, not both.
The breakdown source. Omit it for the KPI's default source.
A date the KPI's frequency allows. A weekly KPI rejects a mid-week date.
True writes actual, false leaves the stored value untouched.
True writes target, false leaves the stored value untouched.
True writes notes, false leaves the stored text untouched.
True adds actual to the stored value instead of replacing it.
